lines.text: Pilate asks Jesus if He is the King of the Jews, and Jesus gives no answer to the charges.
At the feast the governor releases a prisoner of the crowd's choosing, and Pilate offers them Barabbas or Jesus.
Pilate knows Jesus was handed over out of fear, and his wife says to have nothing to do with Him.
The chief priests and elders persuade the crowds to ask for Barabbas, and the crowd shouts "Crucify Him!"
Pilate washes his hands before the crowd, releases Barabbas, has Jesus chained, and hands Him over to be crucified.
